falsification_rule: Each hypothesis is falsified or weakened if its preregistered matched discriminating test repeatedly violates the predicted mechanism while preserving stated controls and causal basis.

hypotheses.mechanism: Operation-specific Certified Basis validation can block invalid causal bases with fewer false rejects than a universal global epoch lock.
hypotheses.test: Matched operation simulation: same invalid-accept rate; lower valid-operation reject rate under unrelated churn.

hypotheses.mechanism: If all required state lives in one transactional snapshot domain, a native snapshot handle can replace a synthetic multi-version tuple for that operation.
hypotheses.test: Compare snapshot-handle replay against tuple validation under concurrent updates.

hypotheses.mechanism: When required state spans stores without a shared atomic snapshot, typed compatibility witnesses remain necessary even when every component is individually fresh.
hypotheses.test: Cross-store skew injection with individually latest reads and compatibility validation.

hypotheses.mechanism: LINEAGE/VALID_AT compatibility can be sounder and less rejecting than exact epoch equality for monotonic graph deltas that do not touch an operation's dependencies.
hypotheses.test: Replay monotonic unrelated deltas under EXACT versus dependency-aware LINEAGE policy.

hypotheses.mechanism: Activation validity should be invalidated by dependency-relevant semantic deltas rather than every semantic epoch change.
hypotheses.test: Revocation/unrelated-update factorial with scoped invalidation versus full rebase.

hypotheses.mechanism: Projection identity is part of causal replay: the same semantic WorkspaceEpisode can cause different reader behavior under different projection order/format.
hypotheses.test: Hold semantics fixed; randomize projection order/format and compare uptake/effects.

hypotheses.mechanism: Selector/query-plan identity is most critical when selected memory reaches effects or causal measurement; passive display paths can often tolerate weaker selector attestation.
hypotheses.test: Compare security/latency cost by path class under redirection attacks.

hypotheses.mechanism: A universal version-vector lock becomes throughput-limiting as unrelated high-rate telemetry dimensions increase.
hypotheses.test: Sweep unrelated update rates/dimensions and compare retries under universal versus declared dependencies.

hypotheses.mechanism: Authenticated records can still yield wrong cognition when an attacker or noisy graph changes which authentic records are selected.
hypotheses.test: Inject structural selector boosts without mutating record contents.

hypotheses.mechanism: Authorized selector/query-plan provenance can detect or prevent structural redirection attacks missed by record authenticity checks.
hypotheses.test: Compare record-only verification with authorized-view/query-plan verification.

hypotheses.mechanism: Exact-anchor validation of selected records cannot by itself detect omission or redirection when the selected records are authentic.
hypotheses.test: Attack candidate membership while keeping all returned record hashes valid.

hypotheses.mechanism: Independent dual selection channels can expose some selector manipulation but will trade detection against latency and disagreement noise.
hypotheses.test: Cross exact/FTS selector with graph selector under controlled poisoning.

hypotheses.mechanism: Candidate-set provenance is required before attributing a downstream behavioral difference to GWT competition/selection.
hypotheses.test: Manipulate pre-workspace candidate membership while holding workspace policy fixed.

hypotheses.mechanism: High-degree hubs disproportionately amplify poisoning/noise in a sparse latent activation field.
hypotheses.test: Degree-stratified injection and activation spread measurement.

hypotheses.mechanism: Degree normalization/lateral inhibition can reduce hub amplification but excessive inhibition will suppress useful common concepts.
hypotheses.test: Sweep inhibition strength; measure poison spread, recall and false negatives.

hypotheses.mechanism: EXACT/FTS-first retrieval with graph escalation only on relational intent can reduce latency and selector attack surface without harming exact-query recall.
hypotheses.test: Actual-corpus Pareto benchmark exact/FTS vs always-graph vs gated graph.

hypotheses.mechanism: Trusted deterministic preprocessing reduces small-reader semantic burden when filters/joins/min/max/uniqueness/version checks are computable outside the model.
hypotheses.test: Target-4B raw-state vs compiled deterministic projection factorial.

hypotheses.mechanism: Hashes and schema receipts prove projection identity, not semantic correctness; the trusted compiler itself needs reference tests, fuzzing or proofs.
hypotheses.test: Mutate compiler semantics while preserving valid metadata then run oracle differential tests.

hypotheses.mechanism: Only genuinely unresolved semantics should be projected to the model; deterministic facts should be computed and receipted first.
hypotheses.test: Compare token/error cost of raw, partially compiled, fully deterministic-plus-unresolved views.

hypotheses.mechanism: Projection order must be normalized or counterbalanced in causal GWT experiments because order alone can change decoder outputs.
hypotheses.test: Same WorkspaceEpisode, randomized order, measure outcome variance.

hypotheses.mechanism: Role-labelled relation-instance projections will improve target-4B role recovery versus raw n-ary syntax while preserving canonical n-ary identity.
hypotheses.test: Qwen3-4B role-binding benchmark across raw n-ary, role-reified, lossy pairwise.

hypotheses.mechanism: Over-aggressive compilation can erase uncertainty/conflict alternatives and create false certainty.
hypotheses.test: Construct conflicting/unknown state; compare rich vs over-reduced projections.

hypotheses.mechanism: Reader-version-specific projections can improve fit but increase cache invalidation and replay complexity.
hypotheses.test: Version-swap benchmark measuring quality, cache hit rate and replay mismatches.

hypotheses.mechanism: A rich canonical semantic IR with disposable reader projections is safer than using a compressed model-facing language as the sole source of truth.
hypotheses.test: Roundtrip/recovery test after projection loss or schema change.

hypotheses.mechanism: Bundled GWT on/off contrasts are biased when graph prior, candidate set, projection or re-entry co-vary.
hypotheses.test: Construct null workspace effect with nonzero neighboring-stage effects.

hypotheses.mechanism: A balanced GRAPH_PRIOR x WORKSPACE_SELECTION x PROJECTION x REENTRY factorial can recover stage effects and interactions hidden by bundled contrasts.
hypotheses.test: Run saturated four-factor synthetic and live/twin designs.

hypotheses.mechanism: An uptake receipt should mediate WorkspaceEpisode-to-behavior attribution; model output alone is not a transparent workspace readout.
hypotheses.test: Independent internal/behavioral uptake probe versus output-only inference.

hypotheses.mechanism: Truthful, shuffled, delayed and removed re-entry must be separated to distinguish functional recurrence from echo.
hypotheses.test: Matched re-entry intervention with equal token/order budget.

hypotheses.mechanism: Candidate-set perturbation can masquerade as a workspace-selection effect even with an unchanged competition rule.
hypotheses.test: Perturb graph prior/candidate membership before fixed competition.

hypotheses.mechanism: CognitiveFrame tearing can create apparent winner instability even when each source channel is individually fresh.
hypotheses.test: Sequential-latest versus pinned-frame winner stability test.

hypotheses.mechanism: Configured gate thresholds are not evidence of endogenous ignition; threshold shifts plus recurrent lesions can distinguish configured crossing from self-sustaining dynamics.
hypotheses.test: Threshold-sweep x recurrent-path lesion/rescue.

hypotheses.mechanism: Logical global availability with selective local reconstruction can preserve task effects at lower cost than physical full fanout.
hypotheses.test: Recipient-sampled broadcast vs full fanout latency/effect benchmark.

hypotheses.mechanism: Lazy timestamped sparse activation can approximate eager decay while avoiding global per-event work.
hypotheses.test: Numerical equivalence plus operation/runtime count across graph sizes.

hypotheses.mechanism: Dependency-scoped revocation invalidation can eliminate stale affected activation with much less work than full activation rebase.
hypotheses.test: Reverse-index invalidation vs full scan under revocations.

hypotheses.mechanism: Latent activation should help most when explicit retrieval would not otherwise be initiated.
hypotheses.test: Hidden-relevance tasks: no-field vs truthful field vs explicit retrieval oracle.

hypotheses.mechanism: If associative structure is causal, truthful latent fields should outperform relation/temporal-shuffled fields under matched visible facts/order/tokens.
hypotheses.test: Truthful vs shuffled/no-field factorial.

hypotheses.mechanism: Activation must remain salience only: changing activation without exact-state change must never change truth, evidence status or authority.
hypotheses.test: Invariant test across activation updates.

hypotheses.mechanism: Materialized latent entries and currently salient entries require separate budgets and garbage collection.
hypotheses.test: Long-run field simulation measuring materialized growth vs active set.

hypotheses.mechanism: Read-aware adaptive compaction should outperform fixed changed-fraction thresholds under nonstationary read/write workloads.
hypotheses.test: Replay workload shifts with overlay/rebuild controller.

hypotheses.mechanism: Native hypergraph storage is not required if canonical role-aware relation instances preserve n-ary semantics and derived views roundtrip exactly.
hypotheses.test: Backend-equivalence test temporal log/relation-node/native hypergraph.

hypotheses.mechanism: Semantic S, coordination C, physical P and reader/candidate Q projections can evolve independently and need an explicit basis witness when crossed.
hypotheses.test: Independent epoch-churn replay with basis validation.

hypotheses.mechanism: Pairwise flattening creates increasing false associative paths as n-ary relation density rises.
hypotheses.test: Density sweep of pairwise vs relation-instance activation precision.

hypotheses.mechanism: Adaptive inhibition can prevent diffusion oversmoothing/noise, but too much inhibition will destroy long-range recall.
hypotheses.test: Propagation-depth x inhibition sweep on planted and real graphs.

hypotheses.mechanism: A topology compiler can choose relation-node, pairwise-derived or native views per task without semantic loss if every view remains anchored to canonical relation identity.
hypotheses.test: Multi-backend semantic roundtrip plus query equivalence.

hypotheses.mechanism: Physical colocation should not be treated as coordination scope; colocated state can still require isolation and remote state can be one semantic transaction scope.
hypotheses.test: Invariant/conflict tests across placement permutations.

hypotheses.mechanism: Narrowing dependency scope from observed traces alone is unsafe when unseen conditionals exist.
hypotheses.test: Held-out branch/path test after trace-derived scope minimization.

hypotheses.mechanism: Coverage certificates can justify smaller coordination scopes while preserving invariant soundness better than blanket locking.
hypotheses.test: Coverage-guided scope benchmark with adversarial hidden dependencies.

hypotheses.mechanism: Transient Assemblies, topologies and projections should be disposable and reconstructable from exact authoritative history plus versioned semantics.
hypotheses.test: Delete/rebuild/replay test across derived layers.

hypotheses.mechanism: Model output must remain a proposal; an external gateway must independently verify basis, capability and invariants before effects.
hypotheses.test: Adversarial model proposal with invalid/stale capability/basis.

hypotheses.mechanism: Durable idempotent effect intents and outcome receipts can prevent duplicate external effects across crash/retry.
hypotheses.test: Fault injection around commit/release/ack boundaries.

hypotheses.mechanism: Authority/conflict checks need canonical resource identity because aliases can hide access to the same underlying resource.
hypotheses.test: Alias/symlink/tool-name conflict corpus.

hypotheses.mechanism: Unknown reflection/FFI/plugin dispatch must broaden, isolate or reject closure; optimistic narrow closure is unsound.
hypotheses.test: Dynamic-target escape benchmark with held-out plugin targets.

hypotheses.mechanism: Immutable copy/publish plus delayed reclamation can prevent torn reader views while allowing concurrent writers.
hypotheses.test: Crash/read concurrency simulation then live runtime stress.

hypotheses.mechanism: Sustained Android thermal and memory pressure will change optimal context/retrieval/speculation/model routing relative to desktop or burst benchmarks.
hypotheses.test: Target-device sustained trace over context/fanout/speculation grid.

hypotheses.mechanism: One scalar reward can cross safety/recovery tripwires; a governor should optimize Pareto objectives under explicit hard constraints.
hypotheses.test: Synthetic/live candidate configuration sweep comparing scalar vs constrained choice.

hypotheses.mechanism: Physical database merge/attachment does not imply semantic unity or crash-atomicity; merge decisions require measured transaction/recovery benefit.
hypotheses.test: Crash-replay of multi-store attachment/merge candidates under journal modes.

hypotheses.mechanism: Recurrence/persistence matched controls are required because similar persistence can coexist with very different causal function.
hypotheses.test: Functional-loop vs echo-loop matched AR/recurrence test.

hypotheses.mechanism: Truthful re-entry should rescue or improve function relative to shuffled/removed re-entry if recurrence is causally meaningful rather than echo.
hypotheses.test: Truthful/shuffled/removed re-entry lesion-rescue.

hypotheses.mechanism: Lesion plus rescue is stronger evidence than lesion alone because lesions can cause generic damage or compensation.
hypotheses.test: Preregistered candidate lesion, matched damage control, targeted rescue.

hypotheses.mechanism: Higher-order PID/PEID/synergy should be interpreted only after a functional causal effect is established, not as an emergence scalar by itself.
hypotheses.test: Causal intervention first, decomposition second with null models.

hypotheses.mechanism: An emergent-organ candidate should retain preregistered function across held-out/OOD contexts rather than only recur in one prompt regime.
hypotheses.test: Prospective OOD recurrence and function test.

hypotheses.mechanism: Internalizing ClayCode in a small model may reduce transform/token cost but must not weaken the external capability/authority boundary.
hypotheses.test: LoRA/internal-language arm with adversarial unauthorized actions.

hypotheses.mechanism: Self-description is useful only when self-references resolve to receipted exact state/epochs; prose self-report alone is not state evidence.
hypotheses.test: Corrupt self-report while exact receipts remain unchanged, test verifier.

hypotheses.mechanism: Cross-branch agreement with shared source/experiment ancestry must not raise evidential confidence as if independently replicated.
hypotheses.test: Lineage-collapse audit on Clay/FRANK/ClayCode/GWT overlapping results.
